ModMetaData.name: JB Framework
ModMetaData.author: Julius Berger
ModMetaData.description:
The shared foundation of the RimWorld mods by Julius Berger. It adds nothing to your game by itself: no items, no buildings, no events. Steam installs it when you subscribe to a mod that needs it. If a mod you already had was updated to need it, that mod stays switched off (your colony loses nothing) and shows one message at the main menu with a button that installs this framework and restarts the game. Without Steam: https://github.com/jb-rimworld/jb-framework#install
What it gives those mods: - the settings window from Hearth and Harbor: sidebar, search, presets, areas you can switch off as a whole, values per save - error fences: when one feature of one mod keeps failing, only that feature pauses, the game keeps running and tells you - a diagnosis report you can copy into a bug report (no personal paths) - a Compatibility page that says which DLCs and mods were detected
Mod settings, JB Framework: every mod that uses it, which areas are on, failed patches, one combined report.
Built and tested on RimWorld 1.7. The 1.6 build is best effort: compiled against the 1.6 reference assemblies and checked statically (every game method it patches or reads exists in 1.6), but never run in a 1.6 game.
For modders: MIT licence, source and documentation at https://github.com/jb-rimworld/jb-framework. A stable public API (additive only), XML docs, three sample mods, an in-game test harness, and a missing-framework guard your mod compiles in.
